zh-CN.title: 八仙唤醒轨迹上线
items: 八仙聚力活动页改为连续滚动的电影画卷，并更新联名标识、规则与奖池视觉
八位仙人按唤醒顺序展开，未解锁时呈现剪影，解锁后会展示彩色人物与唤醒成员头像

en.title: The Baxian awakening trail arrives
items: The Baxian event is now a continuous cinematic scroll with refreshed co-branding, rules, and prize visuals
All eight immortals now form an awakening trail with silhouettes for locked stages and contributor portraits for unlocked stages
